## Why This Is Asked

```yaml
# example: minimal Route53 failover and DR bucket
Resources:
  DRBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket

      Bucket: !Ref DRBucket
      PolicyDocument:

            Action: "s3:GetObject"
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${DRBucket}/*"
```

}
